scientific_integrity: Proof identifies known exponential-convolution representation and classical double-Volterra spectral asymptotics separately from the constrained optimization; numerical diagnostics are finite.
scientific_limitations: Classical weighted Volterra asymptotics may cover the generic singular-value law. The minimum is unattained for continuously differentiable multipliers when L>1. No external independent evaluation.
title: Sharp spectral-tail extremizers for monotone multipliers of the real-variable Cesàro operator
